pro_course_detail.description:
Ces lessons sont faites pour améliorer votre Français dans une conversation, pour vous habituer à comprendre le Français venant d'une personne native, ainsi que pour travailler sur votre prononciation. Nous choisirons ensemble un sujet intéressant et ludique pour chaque session.

These sessions are made to improve your conversational skills, to get used to hear French from a native speaker and to work on your pronunciation. We'll choose an interesting topic together for every session and work our way around it.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description: These sessions are made to improve your conversational skills, to get used to hear English from a fluent speaker and to work on your pronunciation and vocabulary. We'll choose an interesting topic together for every session and work around it.

pro_course_detail.title: Solfège - Music Theory in French
pro_course_detail.description:

L'objectif est à la fois de pratiquer la langue française et d'obtenir de nouvelles informations de théorie musicale.

In this lesson, we will combine conversational practice with formal teaching, with the objective to discover, explore or deepen your understanding of music theory and musical practice. The goal is to practice your conversational skills, as well as strengthen your knowledge of music theory.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I am a community tutor here on Italki. I have previously tutored pupils at primary schools, and I also tutor nurse students who are moving to Finland.

I am a patient, kind and positive teacher. I believe in teaching things that you will actually be able to use in your life. I will help you with topics that you want to learn, and teach you both grammar and vocabulary in a balanced way.

When it comes to Finnish, I can teach you both spoken and written Finnish, and we can even dabble in some slang that people use in daily conversations in the capital region.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I believe that everyone learns differently. Together we will create a suitable way of learning for you. My main aim is to create a fun and relaxed atmosphere, so that you do not feel stressed or nervous to attend lessons! Do not worry if you're shy, I will never make my students do anything they don't want to. 

*IMPORTANT*

- If a student is late for a lesson and does not inform me of it, I will wait for 15 minutes, after which if the student is absent, the lesson will be considered completed and no refund will be issued.
- Unfortunately I don't teach small children (<13) at the moment.

Together we will build your confidence in the language!

course_info.trial_description: A trial lesson is a lesson for new students! During the trial lesson we will get to know each other, establish your language learning goals and discuss learning methods that suit you.

pro_course_detail.title: Keskusteluharjoitusta / Finnish Conversation Practice [25/40/55/85min]
pro_course_detail.description:
Keskustelu- ja lausumisharjoitusta! Keskustelemme haluamastasi aiheesta, katsomme uutta sanastoa ja harjoittelemme puheesi sujuvuutta. Kirjaan ylös uusia sanoja ja kielioppia, joista lähetän sinulle pdf-tiedoston tunnin jälkeen.

- Voimme katsoa jokapäiväisessä keskustelussa käytettäviä rakenteita ja sanontoja.
- Riippuen tasostasi, voimme myös käydä läpi pääkaupunkiseudulla käytettävää slangia ja halutessasi erilaisia suomalaisia murteita.


Conversation and pronunciation practice! We will discuss a topic of your choice, look at new vocabulary and practice the fluency of your speech. I will note down new words and grammar and send them to you as a pdf-file after the lesson.

- I can teach you expressions and structures used by native speakers in everyday conversations.
- Depending on your level, we can also look at slang used in the capital region and different Finnish dialects.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice (all levels) [25/40/55min]
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversation and pronunciation practice! All lessons and topics are adjusted according to the student's needs and wishes. Please let me know in advance if you have special topics you want to talk about!

- We can practice all levels of formality.
- I can teach you expressions and structures used by native speakers in everyday conversations.
- Let's work on making your English sound more natural!

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Finnish with Music 🎶 [25/40/55/85min]
pro_course_detail.description:
Increase your vocabulary, discover idioms and popular Finnish phrases, and learn how to sound like a native speaker by listening to Finnish music with me! Together we will listen to a song, and then focus on the lyrics. We will translate them, and I will give you context to the phrases and words used in the song. You will learn a lot about Finnish culture and its inside jokes!

You can choose a song in advance, or I can offer you a few options from which you can then choose one that you like. We can listen to anything from Finnish classics to new hit songs! 🎶

Laajenna sanavarastoasi, löydä sanontoja ja suosittuja suomenkielisiä fraaseja, sekä opi kuulostamaan natiivipuhujalta kuuntelemalla suomalaista musiikkia! Yhdessä kuuntelemme biisin, minkä jälkeen käännämme sen ja keskitymme sen sanoihin. Opit taatusti paljon Suomen kulttuurista!

Voit valita itse kappaleen etukäteen, tai voin tarjota sinulle muutamia vaihtoehtoja, joista pääset valitsemaan. Voimme kuunnella kaikkea suomalaisista klassikoista uudempiin hitteihin! 🎶

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading & homework help (NO LIVE LESSON)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have a text/CV/cover letter/article/homework that you need help with? 

I will read through your work, check it, and provide you a corrected document with explanations. If you then need more help with your text, you can let me know, and we can book you a live lesson, where we can discuss your text together.

Book ANY time from my calendar, as it will NOT be a live lesson, but I will spend the lesson time going through your work.

Choose an appropriate length for the "lesson":

30min - homework (no essays)
45min - CVs, cover letters
60min - texts up to 2 pages
90min - texts 2-3 pages

If your text is longer than 3 pages, contact me, and I will send you my prices for long texts.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's Read Together! 📖 [25/40/55min]
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's learn English by reading together! We will choose a book or a text that we will then read. You will read aloud, I will help with your pronunciation, and we will go through the text to make sure you understand it. 

The perfect way to enrich your vocabulary and learn good phrases!

pro_course_detail.title: Help with homework or assignments
pro_course_detail.description:
Tällä tunnilla voimme katsoa läpi tehtäviä, joiden kanssa tarvitset apua. Voit myös varata tämän tunnin, jos haluat, että tarkistan tehtäväsi ilman, että tapaamme tunnin aikana (laita viestiä asiasta).

During the lesson we can look through any assignments you might have, and I can answer your questions about grammar and spelling. You can also book this class, if you want me to check your assignments or homework without meeting via video (let me know via message if you want to meet up or not).

teacher_info.intro:
❤️ Because I strongly believe in my students' abilities, I teach French with all my heart.

Hello !  My name is Geethan. 

I'm a native French speaker, fluent in English, Spanish, German, Swedish and currently at an intermediate level of Vietnamese.

I was born and raised on the Côte d'Azur, France, but have traveled and in lived in various countries such as, Sweden, Belgium, Ukraine, Spain and the Canary Islands.

PS : I'm a bit a chatty guy so if you're shy or an introvert, we just might be a good match. 
Otherwise let's say you'll pick up a good deal of French. ➡️
teacher_info.introduction: <Français> Tu as toujours voulu te lancer en français mais n'a pas encore fait le grand saut ? Tu souhaites apprendre avec un ami plutôt qu'un professeur ? <English> Do you want to improve your English step by step with someone who picked up the language from zero ? Are you looking for a friendly teacher that listens carefully to your needs and tailors the lessons according to your goals ? <Français> Alors on a peut-être du chemin à faire ensemble. J'enseigne le français et l'anglais depuis plus de 10 ans. Avoir voyagé à travers le monde et vécu dans plusieurs pays m'a permis de développer une méthode d'apprentissage flexible. Après notre leçon de test, on aura déterminé ton niveau et tes buts en français. A partir de là, je mets sur pied la méthode adéquate pour que tu arrives rapidement à des résultats concrets. <English> Then I have a feeling that we're gonna get along. I've been teaching French and English for more than 10 years. After traveling the world and lived in different countries, I can say that a good teacher is one that takes care of his students almost like they were his own children. After you schedule your trial lesson, I'll know what level you are at and the goals you want to reach. From there on, I pick among the different teaching methods I have used over the years. In the first lesson, we will outline together a study plan based on your availability and the time you are willing to dedicate to your french learning journey.

course_info.trial_description:
Let us meet and start to know each other ! This will help me understand your expectations and your level. Also, trial lesson is a very good tool to see if we get along well in a teacher-student relationship. Of course, we can also start to practice what you wish to work on and improve. 

Vamos a conocernos ! Eso me ayudara para entender lo que esperas con esas lecciones y tu nivel. También, la lección de prueba es una buena manera de constatar si nos caemos bien como profesor y como estudiante. Obviamente, también podemos empezar a practicar lo que quieres trabajar y mejorar. 

Rencontrons nous et faisons connaissance ! Cela me permettra de comprendre vos attentes vis à vis de ces leçons et votre niveau. La leçon d'essai est également un très bon outil pour savoir si nous nous correspondons bien en tant qu'élève et que professeur. Bien entendu, nous pouvons également commencer à pratiquer ce que vous souhaitez travailler et améliorer.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational practice
pro_course_detail.description:
The purpose of this lesson is to be able to converse and react about everyday's subjects. We can start the conversation and let it go randomly to see where it leeds or talk about some specific subject you would like to be able to deal with. This type of lesson will improve your talking and listening and you will learn some vocabulary. 

El propósito de esta lección es ser capaz de conversar y responder sobre los temas del dia a dia. Podemos empezar la conversación y dejar los temas abiertos o tratar de algo especifico que quieres dominar. Este tipo de lección te permite trabajar la expresión oral y escuchar aprendiendo vocabulario al mismo tiempo. 

Le but de cette leçon est d'être capable de converser et de réagir sur des sujets du quotidien. Nous pouvons commencer la conversation puis la laisser dériver de manière aléatoire pour voir où elle nous mène ou bien traiter d'un sujet en particulier que vous souhaitez aborder. Ce type de leçon permet de travailler sur l'expression oral et l'écoute tout en apprenant un peu de vocabulaire.

pro_course_detail.title: Rules of english
pro_course_detail.description:
In these lessons, we can work on scholar topics like grammar, spelling, pronunciation, reading and listening.  We can focus on the areas you want to improve and use many different king of documents to do so (videos, musics, websites...). This lesson needs to be adapted to the student needs and wishes to fit him perfectly and help him improve. 
I personally think it is interesting and efficient to use homework in these kind of lessons so if you are motivated enough you will have to work a bit between the sessions. 

En esas lecciones, trabajaremos los temas escolares como gramática, ortografía, pronunciación, lectura y escuchar. Podemos centrarnos en los temas que quieres mejorar usando muchos documentos diferentes (videos, musicas, sitios web...). Este tipo de lección necesita ser adaptado a las necesidades y a los deseos del estudiante para que lo haga suyo y que sea eficiente para mejorar.  
Pienso que es interesante y eficiente utilizar tareas en este tipo de lecciones así que si estas motivado te voy a dar un poco de trabajo entre las sesiones.  

Dans ces leçons, nous allons travailler des thèmes scolaires spécifiques tels que la grammaire, l'orthographe, la prononciation, la lecture ou l'écoute. Nous pouvons nous concentrer sur les domaines que vous souhaitez améliorer et utiliser tous les supports possible pour cela (vidéo, musiques, sites web...). Ce type de leçon doit être adapté aux besoins et aux envies de l'étudiant pour qu'il se l'approprie et que cela soit efficace pour s'améliorer.
Je trouve intéressant et efficace d'utiliser les devoirs dans ce genre de leçons donc si vous êtes suffisamment motivé je vous donnerez du travail à faire entre les sessions de cours.
